difficulty_reason: With the notation of the surrounding section, for closed subschemes Z contained in Y inside X the lemma asserts o^*[C_Z X]_n = [C_Z Y]_{n-1} in CH_{n-1}(Y x_{o, C_Y X} C_Z X) (statement lines 12259-12266). The proof compares the two blowups W -> P^1_X in infinity(Z) and W' -> P^1_X in infinity(Y); since infinity(Z) is contained in infinity(Y) the inclusion of ideal sheaves gives a map of graded algebras and hence a canonical rational map U -> W' with U open in W, by Constructions, Lemma labelled constructions-lemma-morphism-relative-proj (proof lines 12268-12278). Two local calculations, both explicitly omitted, identify U as containing the complement of the fibre over infinity together with C_Z X, and identify the induced morphism U_infinity -> W'_infinity with the canonical morphism C_Z X -> C_Y X of normal cones (proof lines 12280-12287). The proof then takes W'' the strict transform of P^1_Y in W, which is the blowup of P^1_Y in infinity(Z) by Divisors, Lemma labelled divisors-lemma-strict-transform, so that (W'' cap U)_infinity = C_Z Y, and compares the two ways of applying the Gysin maps: on the one hand (i'_infinity)^* i^* [U]_{n+1} = i_infinity^* i^* [U]_{n+1} = i_infinity^* [(W'' cap U)_infinity]_{n+1} = [C_Z Y]_n using that i_infinity^* kills classes supported over infinity and that i^*[U] and [W''] agree over A^1, while on the other hand the same expression equals i^* i_infinity^* [U]_{n+1} = i^* [U_infinity] = o^* [C_Y X]_n using that (i'_infinity)^* and i^* commute by Lemma labelled lemma-gysin-commutes-gysin and the factorization of the fibre over infinity as o followed by the open immersion C_Y X -> W'_infinity (proof lines 12289-12322). Comparing the two evaluations of the same Gysin pullback is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2; note that the two local calculations are left to the reader by the author, which we record verbatim in the editorial notes.
